collection.title: Ford Ranger 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Ranger 2016 - 2022 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 15" for the passengers side with a Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
